construction: hand3/hand6: seeded Game.setup with each hero at its fixed seat; moveCard adjusts only observer hand using current seeded deck, then startTurn and assertCardLocations. Explicit legal fixtures, not claimed natural trajectories. history100: naturally play all six heroes in this order with candidate vs v1.3, starts 0..5 and candidate colors red/blue in that order; first ordinary non-refresh decision per hero with at least 100 stored public events. Stop seed scan once all six captured. Report missing cells without substituting seeds.
measurement: Same-process public replayTrace scoring only, not production end-to-end latency. Each 10-snapshot cell gets one unmeasured warmup per policy and snapshot, then 5 measured repetitions. Alternate policy order by repetition and snapshot. Quantiles sorted[floor(N*q)], max retained. Report each cell separately, raw times retained. Raw historical replay may include diagnostic pass; no game is driven through replayTrace.
scheduling: Construct and verify snapshots now. Formal timing only after parent confirms 25920-game run completed. No automatic rerun of failed cells; any rerun retained separately with reason.
limitations: Deterministic fixtures cover specified states, not exhaustive hero states. Natural long-history hand counts vary. Concurrent host noise remains possible even after match jobs finish. No policy or weight tuning permitted.
